notes.title: Broadcast to Claude or Codex only
notes.body: Broadcast can now target one agent: pick Claude or Codex and only those terminals are selected, so a Claude command never lands in a Codex prompt. Each terminal in the list shows which agent it runs.
notes.detail: With Codex picked, the resume preset becomes codex resume --last. On the phone, the agent choice combines with the cohort (Needs you, Idle, …).

notes.title: Home Screen app without Safari bars
notes.body: Pairing on a phone now stays on this site, so an app added to the Home Screen opens full screen with no address bar or toolbar. A phone that asks for the desktop site now gets the full dashboard.
notes.detail: If your Home Screen icon still shows the bars, remove it and add it again from this site: Share → Add to Home Screen.
notes.where: Share → Add to Home Screen (Safari or Chrome)
notes.where_phone: Share → Add to Home Screen, or aA → Request Desktop Website

notes.title: More screen on iPhone, and a layout switch
notes.body: In Safari, swipe up in the terminal and the address bar and toolbar slide away. You can also switch between the phone layout and the full dashboard on any phone or tablet.
notes.detail: For no Safari bars at all, add Son of Anton to your Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen).
notes.where_phone: Settings → Layout, and Settings → Hide Safari bars when scrolling

notes.title: Arrange the side panels your way
notes.body: Swap the sidebar and the context panel, or put both on the left, side by side. The layouts are called Standard, Swapped and Both left.

notes.title: Read and edit code in the side panel
notes.body: Open your project’s files in tabs, make a change and save it. Jump to any file or search the whole project, on your Mac or your phone.
notes.detail: Shortcuts: Cmd-S saves, Cmd-P opens a file, Cmd-Shift-F finds in files. Editing goes through a small code service that runs on your Mac.
notes.where_phone: Tap Code in the view bar

notes.title: A few fixes
notes.body: Narrow windows no longer leave an empty column, and the sidebar stays solid over the terminal in Liquid Glass and Windows 11. Restart server has its icon back.
